An experiment is executed to determine if spending too much time on social media hurts cognitive ability. The following data is a summary of that experiment.

Social | Higher | Lower
Y      |    1   | 120
N      |   118  |  2


Assuming the null hypothesis is that using social results in lower cognitive ability, and alpha is .05:
What is the alternative hypothesis?
```{r}
# alternative hypothesis - This is the statement that contradcits the null hypothesis.
print("The alternative hypothesis to 'social media results in lower cognitive ability' is 'social media does not result in lower cognitive ability or results in higher cognitive ability'")
```
